scope: offline Meta-HPO target/loss/feature trial bank; source-identical frozen F72/UnderF120 parent with append-only feature overlays

model.family: LightGBM Rank-XENDCG; frozen UnderF120 parent parameters

under.definition: strict-prequential unexpected favorable policy residual with trailing activation

over.definition: strict-prequential unexpected adverse stop-loss or fast-adverse residual

magnitude.definition: strict-prequential rich-policy-net residual ordinalized into train-only seven quantile grades

selection.contract: Each candidate is a replacement candidate for the existing Under F120 meta slot. It keeps all 120 frozen parent fields and may append selected target-free SHAP/state fields. It is evaluated as Current = 0.75 * Base rank + 0.25 * candidate Under rank; it is never an extra head and does not alter BCF.
selection.screening_rule: Strict-OOF direct metrics are descriptors only. No fixed weighted metric, percentile rank, or direct-score gate can select a trial. The versioned learned PriorityProxy and GateProxy contract is the only HPO/feature-selection proxy; complete matched MC1 evidence remains the sole advancement authority.

full_stack_objective.scope: For only the top two screen-qualified candidates plus frozen Under F120 control: target-free OOF score receipts, separate strict six-complete-calendar-month BCF and Current MC1 maps, dual expected-policy-net >= 50 bps admission, one chronological constrained portfolio.
full_stack_objective.primary: highest constrained total net policy bps

non_regression_gates.monthly_portability: positive delta in at least half of held months and no single-month-only improvement

tie_breakers: higher constrained net EV per trade
fewer fields and simpler HPO geometry
full_stack_objective.selection_note: Any winner replaces the one Under F120 model inside the fixed 25% Current slot. It never becomes a parallel head.

feature_selection.always_present: all 120 frozen current Under F120 fields
feature_selection.conditional_retention_rule: A lower-support feature can advance only when its conditional effect is non-reversing in the declared context, it occurs in >=8/12 folds or >=6 folds with the same context direction, and it improves the matched full-stack objective.

selection.advancement: Direct timestamp-level evidence is only a funnel. Full-stack MC1/admission/portfolio evidence is the sole advancement authority.

causality.feature_inputs: complete frozen 120-field parent plus declared target-free additive overlays only
causality.labels: policy/path labels join only after held target-free score persistence and resolve before fold reserve
